create_random_dataset: create a RandomDataset instance generating uniform random dense and sparse features for DLRM benchmark training
create_synthetic_dataset: create a SyntheticDataset instance loading pre-generated synthetic data from a folder for DLRM benchmark training
run_data_loader: run the data_loader function to get a DataLoader for random or synthetic DLRM training data
generate_uniform_input_batch: generate a batch of uniform random dense features and sparse embedding indices for DLRM input
generate_random_output_batch: generate a batch of random target values representing click probability for DLRM output
